Chapter 7087: Bastard

Chapter 7087: Bastard

“What do you want to know?” Heavenly Whale asked.

“I’ll just take it directly.” Li Qiye said, making listeners shudder in fear. Some even grabbed their head instinctively.

“It’s useless even if you remove my sea of consciousness.” He said confidently.

“Are you sure? Any blessing or protection there is useless against me.” Li Qiye was surprised.

“Haha, there’s no blessing here, I’ve been neutered.” He said gloatingly.

“Is that something to be proud of?” Li Qiye became surprised.

“You’re the one hitting a wall, hahaha.” He laughed.

“We’ll see about that.” Li Qiye smiled and reached inside the fish’s brain to open his mind.

“Ahh!” The mind, lacking blessings and barriers, was entirely exposed.

“Neutered indeed, this is a thing?” Li Qiye said.

“Hahaha, my lord had a perfect strategy and knew today would happen. Those like you will get nothing from me.” He laughed.

“How are you different from a eunuch?” Li Qiye said.

“That’s fine, as long as I can see your bitter expression. It’s like watching that villainous heaven being humiliated.” He seemed ecstatic.

“Is he mad?” Spectators didn’t know what to say.

This was their first time seeing a man happy about having his mind neutered. Keep in mind that this could result in mental instability and degradation.

However, Heavenly Whale seemed pleased to let his lord, Octopus, do so.

“You’re suicidal.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“I haven’t thought about surviving.” He laughed: “There’s no move for you now.”

“That’s fine, just a little octopus with no real secrets to speak of. I’ll get the chance to push him out for some roasted octopus.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Go to Abyss then, it will be a trip with no return with my lord waiting for you.” He said.

“Don’t have to go that far for some roasted octopus.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“Then you will never have the chance.” He laughed.

“Still laughing before death?” Li Qiye asked.

“Why not? This is the most joyous moment of my life, let me do it for you!” A black hole erupted in his mind and swallowed him whole.

“That’s pretty brave...” A spectator said since Heavenly Whale was indeed fearless.

The long lifespan of immortals made them fear death more than anyone. To die without any hesitation like Heavenly Whale was rare.

“Maybe his neutered mind is the reason for his fearlessness.” One immortal said, garnering considerable agreement from the crowd.

Just when everyone thought the black hole would put an end to him, Li Qiye sealed the black hole and said: “An idiot, but you can still be of use. I can’t let you go to waste like this.”

“What are you doing?!” Heavenly Whale shouted.

“I don’t want your useless mind, just your body.” Li Qiye said before starting the grind, pulverizing the fish into pieces.

“Bastard!” He shouted in agony.

“Not the first one to call me this, nor the last because it is indeed the truth. Now, I suppose a neutered mind can still feel pain.” Li Qiye said before finishing the task.

Heavenly Whale’s flesh, grand dao, and karma were refined into pure life liquid and worldly essences. Li Qiye released them back to the world.

This, deliberately or otherwise, sent a message to all the immortals. Being killed by Li Qiye meant returning to the origin entirely.

“Robbed from this world, no more.” Li Qiye said as he landed on Heaven Essence Platform.

“Rumble!” The platform erupted with light and tribulations. The torrential ocean appeared before everyone again, along with the battlefield’s raging grand momentum.
